reviews.text: Such a wonderful team!  They’re efficient, extremely professional and clearly love the animals they care for.  They make taking your pet to the vet easy.

My dog had her teeth cleaned here and I was super nervous because she has vet trauma but they took such good care of my girl and even trimmed her nails while she was under. I've been seeing Dr. Kim for multiple years now and I cannot speak highly enough of her. She always listens to every concern and acknowledges each of them. She's detail oriented and never makes me feel rushed or dismissed or judged. It is clear that she cares about both the animals and their owners. And if she doesn't have an answer for me, she always has a referral to someone else. I plan on moving out of the state next year and will miss Dr. Kim tremendously! She's the best.
Always a good experience here at Midway Hollow!

My dog had a couple of growths removed and tested, both of which turned out to be benign. Thank you Dr. Kim and staff for your great care and attention to detail, despite my dog not loving being at the vet! They did preparatory meetings to review the growths, extra calls to confirm the best path forward, and good care removing the stitches.

Great vet, I’ve been coming here at least 30 years. Dr Carroll was so kind and helpful when my cat Nefertiti was dying of kidney failure. DO NOT BOOK AT THIS pet clinic  I also am warning you not to book with Dr. Passman!
I brought my cat boomer in for continuously vomiting. She suggested blood work and medicated food. I denied the medicated food but paid $200 for the bloodwork. She called me to go over the bloodwork and basically his bloodwork came back looking good. The only thing she recommended was a $500 sonogram which in my opinion is outrageous. I spoke with with her today about two weeks later and I told her he has a gut bacteria and needs antibiotics and she literally told me il on the phone that they don’t prescribe antibiotics for that. I’ve  already spent $300 and all I want is an antibiotic and she is refusing to prescribe it. I told her that My cat (Boomer) was a huge really bit FAT cat and now he’s skin and bones and she 100% lacked any compassion for my animal.  To top it off she completely lying about recommending an injection for  my cat. She never once talked about an injection and I also confirmed this with my roommate who actually brought the cat in. He told me she never recommended an injection and if she did that’s something he would have remembered. Dr. Passman doesn’t care about the health of my cat !
She driven on patients spending more money which is really sad.  DO NOT BOOK WITH DR. Passman!!  I’ll keep you guys posted on boomer’s situation. I bet the next vet I bring him to won’t tell me they don’t provide antibiotics for a gut bacteria.!
Update:  6/11/26 Boomer died last night and it’s all because Dr. Passman refused to prescribe him antibiotics for a bacterial infection in his stomach. Her exact words on the phone were “ I dont prescribe medicine for a cat that is throwing up”.. Dr. Carroll you should really reconsider the doctors you have working for you!…. This business will be shut down within a year! Amen………..

Low prices but not worth it and like others have said they’ll quote you one price on the phone and then require you to buy at least one other thing that your pet “needs” for them to be able to treat them at all…

The staff used to be great but the past several times I’ve gone I had new nurses and veterinarians who were always rushing & had short answers to every question. One nurse giggled and said “math is hard” after miscalculating how much medicine my dog needed and then eventually realizing her mistake (before giving me the medicine luckily). My dogs’ names both start with M and the nurses would keep saying the wrong name for which services each one needed and I had to keep correcting them but again it was all rushed so that was extra unprofessional. Those kinds of mistakes and dismissed concerns of mine where they’d glance at my pet and say they seemed fine kept happening until I eventually switched to CityVet which has been amazing. Plus I thought one of my dogs hated getting her nails trimmed because she’d scream when they took her in the back to do it at Midway hollow but she loves the people at Cityvet cutting her nails!
